purpose: Mutants that are PROVABLY equivalent: no test can kill them because they cannot change any observable value. Each entry states the proof, not an opinion. standard: An entry belongs here only if the mutated and original programs are extensionally equal on the whole input domain. Anything weaker is an admitted gap.
